asks.ask: 8개 파일 각각 I_G/I_D 계산하여 막대그래프 (베이스라인 보정 없이 피크 높이비)

title: Raman I_G/I_D Ratio by Sample
data_code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import glob
import os
samples = []
ratios = []
files = sorted(glob.glob('data/raman/*.csv'))
for f in files:
    try:
        df_raw = pd.read_csv(f)
        shift_col = 'Raman Shift (cm-1)'
        int_col = 'Intensity (a.u.)'
        if shift_col not in df_raw.columns or int_col not in df_raw.columns:
            shift_col = df_raw.columns[0]
            int_col = df_raw.columns[1]
        x_vals = df_raw[shift_col].values
        y_vals = df_raw[int_col].values
        mask_d = (x_vals >= 1300) & (x_vals <= 1400)
        mask_g = (x_vals >= 1550) & (x_vals <= 1620)
        if np.any(mask_d) and np.any(mask_g):
            i_d = np.max(y_vals[mask_d])
            i_g = np.max(y_vals[mask_g])
            ratio = i_g / i_d if i_d > 0 else 0.0
            base_name = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv', '')
            samples.append(base_name)
            ratios.append(ratio)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error processing {f}: {e}")
df_new = pd.DataFrame({'Sample': samples, 'Ratio': ratios})
df = df_new
